shortDescription: Retrieve information about one or more Proxmox VE virtual machines

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: config
options.description: Whether to retrieve the VM configuration along with VM status. If set to V(none) (default), no configuration will be returned. If set to V(current), the current running configuration will be returned. If set to V(pending), the configuration with pending changes applied will be returned.

options.name: name
options.description: Restrict results to a specific virtual machine(s) by using their name. If VM(s) with the specified name do not exist in a cluster then the resulting list will be empty.

options.name: network
options.description: Whether to retrieve the current network status. Requires enabled/running qemu-guest-agent on qemu VMs.

options.name: node
options.description: Restrict results to a specific Proxmox VE node.

options.name: type
options.description: Restrict results to a specific virtual machine(s) type.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: vmid
options.description: Restrict results to a specific virtual machine by using its ID. If VM with the specified vmid does not exist in a cluster then resulting list will be empty.
